[[Milefaun Mindflayer]] is a [[Warden]] [[boss]] that may be encountered during the [[Arborstone]] [[mission]], and who also spawns in [[Mourning Veil Falls]].

== Locations ==
* [[Echovald Forest]]
** {{NPC location|Mourning Veil Falls}} (not during [[Trading Blows]])

== Missions ==
* Echovald Forest
** {{NPC location|Arborstone}}

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Cry of Frustration}}
* {{skill icon|Energy Surge}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Ether Feast}}
* {{skill icon|Shatter Enchantment}}
* {{skill icon|Shatter Hex}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Milefaun's Staff]] ([[unique]])

== Notes ==
* Does not always appear in Arborstone. It shares its one possible [[spawn]] point with [[Ryver Mossplanter]].

== Trivia ==
* [[w:Illithid|Illithid]] (commonly known as ''mind flayer'') is a race of creatures in Dungeons & Dragons.
